status: Retrospective exploratory evaluation; historical WER and V13 scores already inspected. Not preregistration or independent test.
cohort: 100 reused official qual_dev descriptions; original V13 source-length-stratified 30 for human audit

audit.split: Rank the existing 30 by source word length, split into three strata, seed15042 shuffle each; first5/stratum metric development, remaining5 confirmation
audit.confirmation_limit: Prior model/WER inspection means this is only evaluator-confirmation within reused qual_dev, NOT an unseen model test. Do not tune metrics on confirmation then call it independent.
audit.blinding: Random opaque candidate IDs; separate private key. Procedural masking, not guaranteed model-unrecognizability.
audit.denominator: One atomic fact one vote; macro per description primary, micro counts supplementary; unclear remains in denominator
audit.empty_prediction: Retention zero; unsupported rate undefined, not perfect or silently excluded without n reporting
audit.review: Freeze reference facts before candidates; exact source/candidate evidence; all selected sources and all candidate groups required; no automated fact judgments

bertscore.interpretation: Similarity only, not factual accuracy. Do not silently add a different model/layer/rescale baseline.
bertscore.anchor: (mean matched F1 - mean actual shuffled F1) / (mean privileged native F1 - mean actual shuffled F1); no clipping; not semantic accuracy
bertscore.reuse: Validate full row matrix, original prepared/protocol identity, settings and recomputed group means; never import 10-row smoke as full evaluation

challenge.origin: 40 hand-authored synthetic outputs from four synthetic scenes, NOT DOCCI/model results
challenge.purpose: Check paraphrase versus count/color/binding/spatial/negation/action errors, omission and unrelated output; no factual-accuracy threshold
challenge.unit: Scene, not independent variants; report directional wins/ties and gaps, no population significance from four scenes

external_metrics.CAPTURE: Optional strict score-import interface only; actual upstream runtime/weights are NOT bundled, installed, adapted or validated. Quantity/binding limitations must be checked with challenge and human audit.
external_metrics.AlignScore: Optional strict score-import interface only; forward support score, NOT calibrated contradiction probability or recall. Runtime NOT bundled or validated.
external_metrics.freeze: Create manifest-bound plan with evaluator revision/settings/asset SHA256 BEFORE scoring; complete case ID and text hashes required. Keep failure/empty outputs. No silent parsing fallback. Asset hashes are declarations, not proof of execution.

uncertainty: Fixed-output description-cluster paired bootstrap2000/seed42; exploratory intervals, no training-seed/inter-rater uncertainty or multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests
quality_policy: Historical WER, QUALITY_STOP and checkpoints unchanged; engineering completion is NOT a semantic quality pass
digital: NOT_RUN; do not use original text as perfect digital baseline
training: NONE; V14 clean legacy64/released64 comparison remains the next model experiment
